LEGENDS (Darth Plagueis novel, Luceno 2012) unless noted. ROTS film lines are G-canon/film (shared with Canon). Chapter numbers not given by the thread: GAP.
FORCE POWER STATEMENTS
- S: "Darth Plagueis was a Dark Lord of the Sith so powerful and so wise, he could use the Force to influence the midi-chlorians to create life." (ROTS film)
- S: "Seen through the Force, he was a nuclear oval of mottled light, a rotating orb of terrifying energy... a vessel sufficiently strong to contain the full power of the dark side." (Darth Plagueis)
- S: "there were no powers beyond his reach; none he couldn't master through an effort of will. If a Sith of equal power had preceded him..." (Darth Plagueis, his POV)
- S: "Sidious knew that his own powers had increased tenfold over the decades, but he couldn't be certain he had learned all of Plagueis's secrets... Was he a level behind? Two levels behind?" (Darth Plagueis)
- S: Tenebrous: Plagueis's connection was "considerably deeper, broader, and more powerful than Tenebrous had ever suspected." (The Tenebrous Way, short story)
- AUTHOR: James Luceno, Facebook Q&A: "If it had come to a duel, I think Plagueis may have found a way to undermine his apprentice." (author intent: Plagueis > Sidious in a fair duel)
- S: "he and Plagueis were more than equal to the most powerful of the Jedi Order... no match for their combined strength" (Darth Plagueis)
- F: presence causes Naboo's coldest winter, "plasmic quakes rocked the Gallo Mountains" (Darth Plagueis; causation implied)
- F: Plagueis's death: "A tremor took hold of the planet... to shake the stars themselves" (Darth Plagueis; flows into Sidious)
- H: "one of the most brilliant Sith Lords who ever lived" (novel synopsis blurb) [panel: panels/plagueis/plagueis-darth-plagueis-once-powerful-one-brilliant-sith-1.jpg]
COMBAT FEATS
- F: brings the ceiling slabs down on Tenebrous "so quickly... buried almost before he understood" (Darth Plagueis)
- F: beats Venamis (trained in Plagueis's own style), disarms him, "his lightsaber became a blinding rod" (Darth Plagueis)
- F: severely injured (trachea cut, 2 of 3 hearts failing): Force wave "all but atomized the bodies of six Maladians... dragging the wave halfway around the room to kill half a dozen more"; Force bellow shatters eardrums within ten meters; Force shield holds against vibroblades (Darth Plagueis)
- F: deflects all omnidirectional fire of droid rings, Hypori (Darth Plagueis)
- F: absorbs blaster bolts and re-emits them as lightning (Darth Plagueis)
- F: lightning "storm... crackled over the landscape" (Darth Plagueis)
- F: hides his presence from Yoda, Windu, Adi Gallia in the same hall; from Dooku, Qui-Gon, Sifo-Dyas; even Sidious fails to sense him (Darth Plagueis)
- F: resurrects Venamis repeatedly via midi-chlorians; reverses his own aging (Darth Plagueis); Book of Sith: forced midi-chlorians "to override their natural life cycles" in slaves.
- S: "Tenebrous, however, who had pronounced Plagueis a master of the art" [lightsaber] (Darth Plagueis)
- S: Sidious: "The Sith grew past the use of lightsabers" (Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader)
- F (the loss): Sidious kills him while he is drunk/asleep: the lightning only on a sleeping, suffocating Plagueis who "stopped short of defending himself" (Darth Plagueis)
